en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad urban avenue lined with ornate multi‑story buildings in Central European architectural style. In the background stands a large Gothic‑revival style building with steep roofs and pointed towers, and to the right another corner building with a tall spire. The street is busy with pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. At the bottom margin there is a caption in both Romanian and Hungarian.
